raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
`swiglu_clamped()` runs the Triton kernel when Triton is available and `_swiglu_clamped_eager()` otherwise
, The triton kernel accumulates in float32 but the eager function not, which causes `tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_expert_activation.py::TestGroupedExpertsActivation::test_fused_kernel_matches_plain_pytorch[swiglu_oai]`
 fail when triton is not available.

The PR fixes the numeric error, has been validated in H100 and KLXPU, with the cost of larger peek memory and kernel time cost.
| | fwd peak | fwd+bwd peak | fwd+bwd time |
|---|---|---|---|
| before | 2.50 GiB | 4.00 GiB | 13.87 ms |
| after | 5.00 GiB | 10.00 GiB | 32.21 ms |

raw_graphql_pull_request.title: Keep float32 intermediates in the clamped SwiGLU eager fallback

detail.body:
`swiglu_clamped()` runs the Triton kernel when Triton is available and `_swiglu_clamped_eager()` otherwise
, The triton kernel accumulates in float32 but the eager function not, which causes `tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_expert_activation.py::TestGroupedExpertsActivation::test_fused_kernel_matches_plain_pytorch[swiglu_oai]`
 fail when triton is not available.

The PR fixes the numeric error, has been validated in H100 and KLXPU, with the cost of larger peek memory and kernel time cost.
| | fwd peak | fwd+bwd peak | fwd+bwd time |
|---|---|---|---|
| before | 2.50 GiB | 4.00 GiB | 13.87 ms |
| after | 5.00 GiB | 10.00 GiB | 32.21 ms |
detail.title: Keep float32 intermediates in the clamped SwiGLU eager fallback

files.patch:
@@ -437,10 +437,15 @@ def backward(ctx, grad_out: torch.Tensor):
 
 def _swiglu_clamped_eager(gate: torch.Tensor, up: torch.Tensor, alpha: float, limit: float, oai: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
     """Pure-PyTorch reference used as the non-Triton fallback."""
+    if oai:
+        # Only this form scales the gate before the sigmoid: in the input dtype that product
+        # rounds first and the sigmoid amplifies it, past the single rounding the kernel costs.
+        dtype = gate.dtype
+        gate = gate.float().clamp(max=limit)
+        up = up.float().clamp(min=-limit, max=limit)
+        return ((up + 1.0) * (gate * torch.sigmoid(gate * alpha))).to(dtype)
     gate = gate.clamp(max=limit)
     up = up.clamp(min=-limit, max=limit)
-    if oai:
-        return (up + 1.0) * (gate * torch.sigmoid(gate * alpha))
     return F.silu(gate) * up
